authorization.request: 把插件商城入口移到设置左侧独立分区，并让 DSH Desktop 加载商城列表、显示已安装状态并可通过官方安装器安装固定 Commit 插件；展示名为 DSH-Store。

official.desktopInstaller: ctx.remote.pluginManager.inspect and installBundle; waitForInstall recovers an active request
official.desktopRuntimeVersionSource: official pluginManager.listBundles entries with official=true and exact installTarget.version
official.packageDisplayMetadata: locale/en.json and locale/zh.json meta.title, exported by ./locale/*.json

gates: Register DSH-Store as its own settings.section contribution and keep it outside the built-in plugins tab.
Expose the DSH-Store package title through locale/en.json and locale/zh.json while retaining the internal package and Patch IDs.
Desktop catalog loading is bounded and fails closed; only approved entries pinned to canonical GitHub repositories and full Commits are shown as trusted entries.

Read Desktop installed state and exact DSH runtime version through the official pluginManager Remote API; show approved Catalog entries for browsing, but enable installation only when compatibility.profiles explicitly includes desktop and the exact runtime release is declared compatible.
Require a typed per-entry confirmation containing the package name and all 40 Commit characters, call official inspect then installBundle, and do not grant approved build scripts automatically.
Keep Store plan/execute, Profile Patch, enable/disable, uninstall, Guardian and restart paths unavailable in Desktop mode; use the official DSH plugin page for those lifecycle actions.

Run disposable desktop-client contract coverage for profile and version gates, validate the current trusted Catalog through the Desktop reader, and run npm run check; require exact-head CI before merging.
After source merge, prepare a separate fresh Catalog plan and verify GitHub Raw, Pages, dsh.store, and dsh-store.cn; do not claim listing or deployment from this source PR.

rollback.source: Revert only the exact source PR through a CI-checked PR.
rollback.desktopProfile: This plan does not install or change a real Desktop Profile. DSH installation actions are invoked only after the Desktop user completes the explicit typed confirmation in the product UI.

healthCheck: Disposable tests verify Settings section registration, bounded trusted Catalog parsing, explicit Desktop Profile plus exact DSH release compatibility gating, installed-state projection, typed full-Commit confirmation and official inspect/installBundle calls. npm run check and exact-head PR CI must pass.
boundaries: Do not modify DSH source or any @deepseek-ai package.
Do not disable or shadow the official plugin inventory.
Do not use Loader/Fiber mutation APIs or the Store's custom Profile mutation endpoints in Desktop mode.
Do not install, update, enable, disable, uninstall, or restart anything in the user's real Desktop Profile during this source change.
Do not change registry Catalog records or production storefronts in this source PR.
